headline: Price SEO by revenue, not hours
body: Clients renew when they see projected income, not a list of tasks.
caption:
Stop selling SEO as a list of tasks.

Clients renew when the proposal shows projected revenue. Put traffic, conversion rate, and order value into our free ROI calculator and lead with that number.

Run the numbers at upgrowth.io/tools/seo-roi
